title: Register and sign in with a hashed, non-logged credential

scope_out: Password reset by email, SSO, or multi-factor authentication (SG-7); Sign-out (owned by E1-S2)

entities.name: Register and sign in with a hashed, non-logged credential

operations.text:
1. Create `backend/src/types/models.py` — `Member`, `Session`, `RegisterRequest`, `SignInRequest`, `MemberView`, `ErrorBody`.
2. Create `backend/src/config/settings.py` — `DATABASE_URL`, `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME`.
3. Create `backend/src/repository/db.py` — SQLAlchemy engine/session factory.
4. Create `backend/src/repository/member_repository.py` — insert member, get by email.
5. Create `backend/src/repository/session_repository.py` — insert/get session by id.
6. Create `backend/src/services/auth_service.py` — `register`, `sign_in`, `get_current_member`; Argon2id hashing.
7. Create `backend/src/api/deps.py` — `require_session` dependency.
8. Create `backend/src/api/auth.py` — `POST /auth/register`, `POST /auth/sign-in`; sets HTTP-only session cookie.
9. Create `backend/src/logging_config.py` — redacts password/hash from all log output.
10. Create `backend/src/main.py` — FastAPI app wiring; registers the auth router.
11. Create `frontend/src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts` — same-origin proxy to backend register.
12. Create `frontend/src/app/api/auth/sign-in/route.ts` — same-origin proxy to backend sign-in; relays `Set-Cookie`.
13. Add `backend/tests/unit/test_auth_service.py` and `backend/tests/integration/test_auth_api.py` covering AC1–AC4.
